data.name: Web3 Builders India
data.description:
About the Community

Web3 Builders India is a community-driven initiative dedicated to empowering developers, students, founders, creators, and blockchain enthusiasts through education, collaboration, and innovation.

Our mission is to make Web3 accessible to everyone by creating opportunities to learn, build, and connect with the global blockchain ecosystem. Whether you're taking your first steps into blockchain or already building decentralized applications, our community provides a welcoming environment to grow your skills and network with like-minded people.

We organize high-quality technical events, hands-on workshops, hackathons, networking meetups, panel discussions, and open-source collaboration sessions focused on the latest advancements in blockchain technology.

What We Cover

  • Blockchain Fundamentals
  • Smart Contract Development (Solidity & Rust)
  • Ethereum, Polygon, Solana & Layer 2 Ecosystems
  • Tokenization & Real-World Assets (RWA)
  • AI + Web3
  • Decentralized Identity (DID)
  • Web3 Security & Auditing

What We Organize

  • Monthly Community Meetups
  • Technical Workshops
  • Buildathons & Hackathons
  • Demo Days
  • Startup Showcases
  • Founder Fireside Chats

Who Should Join?

  • Software Developers
  • College Students
  • Blockchain Beginners
  • Smart Contract Developers
  • Product Managers
  • Designers
  • Anyone curious about the future of the internet

Why Join?

By becoming a part of Web3 Builders India, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn directly from industry experts and developer advocates.
  • Build real-world blockchain applications through workshops and hackathons.
  • Connect with founders, engineers, mentors, and investors.
  • Contribute to open-source Web3 projects.
  • Discover internship and job opportunities.
  • Showcase your projects during community demo days.
  • Receive exclusive swag, certificates, API credits, and partner benefits.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends across the Web3 ecosystem.

Our Vision

We envision a thriving ecosystem where every developer has access to the knowledge, resources, and community needed to build the decentralized future. By fostering collaboration and continuous learning, we aim to accelerate Web3 adoption across India and beyond.

Our Mission

  • Build an inclusive and collaborative Web3 developer community.
  • Help developers learn through practical, hands-on experiences.
  • Encourage innovation via hackathons and open-source projects.
  • Connect builders with startups, mentors, and industry leaders.
  • Support the growth of the global decentralized ecosystem.

Community Values

  • Learn Together
  • Build Together
  • Share Knowledge
  • Open Source First
  • Collaboration Over Competition
  • Inclusive & Diverse Community
  • Innovation Through Technology

Join Us

Whether you're writing your first smart contract, launching a blockchain startup, contributing to open source, or simply exploring Web3, Web3 Builders India is the place to learn, collaborate, and grow.

Together, let's build the decentralized future.

data.name: Women in Solutions Architecture
data.description:
Solutions Architecture is one of the most exciting yet challenging career paths in technology. It sits at the intersection of technology, business, and pre-sales, where decisions often influence large strategic investments.

Through this panel, we're bringing this story to a wider audience — especially those who aspire to build careers in Solutions Architecture.

 

📅 Date: Thursday, 27 August 🕔 Time: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM

 

Meet Your Speakers

 

Snehil Pandey — Head of Solutions Architecture, ASEAN & GCR DNB EE | Senior Manager, Field Engineering, Databricks As a Field Engineering Manager and former Senior Solutions Architect, Snehil leads a dynamic team of solutions architects, mentoring emerging talent and helping enterprises across ASEAN unlock the full value of their data and AI investments. She specializes in crafting industry-tailored strategies spanning banking and finance, retail, and telecommunications — a perspective shaped by working with global leaders including J.P. Morgan Chase and Boston Consulting Group (BCG).

 

Shelvia Hotama — Senior Solutions Engineer, Confluent Shelvia is a Senior Solutions Engineer at Confluent, where she serves as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them design scalable systems using Confluent's platform and modern data technologies. She began her career as a Software Engineer before transitioning into Solutions Architecture, bringing a builder's mindset to technical solution design and customer engagement. She's passionate about sharing ideas, learning from others, and having honest conversations about the opportunities and challenges shaping the future of technology.

 

Dr. Hiranya Dayal (Ph.D., CPLC) — Founder, Her Intuition Lab A former scientist and product manager turned performance coach, Dr. Dayal helps leaders develop the mindset and nervous system for meaningful, sustainable success. Drawing on her experience across research, technology, and coaching 50+ professionals and founders, she helps people overcome the subconscious patterns behind perfectionism, overthinking, and burnout so they can lead with clarity and execute with confidence.

data.name: The First Brew: Speed Networking
data.description:
Welcome to the very first Bytes & Brew meetup!

We're building a community where tech professionals can connect, learn from one another, and create opportunities together. Whether you're a software engineer, product manager, MBA, founder, AI enthusiast, cloud professional, student, or simply looking to grow your network, this event is for you. data.name: How Singapore's AI Teams Are Really Being Built
data.description:
A Women in Tech (WIT) Singapore Roundtable powered by Salient

Everyone's talking about the AI talent race. Fewer people are talking about who's in the room when these teams get built and who's still fighting for a seat at the table.

Singapore has one of the smaller AI gender gaps globally (~28% of the AI talent pool is women), but women hold only ~30% of leadership roles in AI organisations, and just a fraction of CEO and top technical seats.

Join us for real data, real case studies, and a candid conversation with senior women leaders on what it takes to grow into (and stay in) AI leadership — followed by networking with peers on the same climb.

📅 Date: Wednesday, 13 August 🕒 Time: 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM SGT 

📍 Venue:  WeWork, 9 Battery Road, Level 15, Room 15A, Singapore 049910 

Speaker: Bharath Balasubramanyam, Head of Tech Practice (Singapore), Salient

Bharath Balasubramanyam leads Salient's Tech Practice in Singapore, where he places senior AI, engineering, and cybersecurity talent across the APAC region. He works closely with frontier AI companies, high-growth tech startups, and consultancies as they scale their teams in the region giving him a front-row view into how AI talent pipelines are actually being built, and where the gaps are.

Expect real talk, real numbers, and real networking with women building careers at the frontier of AI.

🎟️ Limited seats — registration required

AGENDA

Time Segment
3:00 – 3:10 PM Welcome & Framing: why this conversation, why now
3:10 – 3:35 PM Data & Case Studies by Bharath Balasubramanyam
3:35 – 4:15 PM Panel / Open Conversation
4:15 – 4:30 PM Audience Q&A
4:30 – 5:00 PM Networking

data.name: Build with AI: AI Agents & Automation
data.description:
As AI evolves beyond chatbots, a new era of Agentic AI is emerging—where systems can reason, plan, take actions, and automate entire workflows with minimal human intervention.

In this event, participants will explore how to build powerful AI systems using tools like n8n, Google Gemini APIs, and Google Opal.

🚀 What You'll Learn

Hands-on Workshop: Building AI Automations with n8n & Google Opal

Learn how modern no-code and low-code platforms are transforming productivity by enabling anyone to build intelligent workflows.

Topics include:
• Introduction to workflow automation and Agentic AI
• Building AI-powered workflows using n8n
• Integrating LLMs into automation pipelines
• Using Google Opal to rapidly prototype and create AI mini-apps and intelligent workflows
• Connecting APIs, databases, and third-party services
• Building practical use cases like:

  • AI Research Assistant
  • Email Automation Agent
  • Content Generation Workflows
  • Personal Productivity Agents

Speaker Session: Building AI Agents with Gemini APIs

Dive deep into the world of autonomous AI systems powered by Google's latest AI technologies.

Topics include:
• Understanding AI Agents and Agentic Workflows
• Gemini API capabilities and multimodal intelligence
• Function Calling and Tool Usage
• Memory, Planning, and Multi-Agent Architectures
• Building production-ready AI Agents
• Real-world applications and startup opportunities in the Agent Economy

💡 Why Attend?

• Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI technologies.
• Learn directly from industry experts and practitioners.
• Understand how companies are leveraging AI Agents to automate tasks and build next-generation products.
• Network with developers, founders, builders, and AI enthusiasts.

🎯 Who Should Attend?

• Developers & Software Engineers
• Students & AI Enthusiasts
• Startup Founders & Product Builders
• Automation Engineers
• Anyone interested in the future of AI and intelligent systems.

Build. Automate. Scale.

The future belongs to intelligent systems that can think, act, and collaborate. Join us to learn how to build them.
